title: Coreset-Induced Conditional Velocity Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2605.12951v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose Coreset-Induced Conditional Velocity Flow Matching (CCVFM), a generative model that augments hierarchical rectified flow with a data-informed source distribution. Standard flow matching regresses only the conditional mean of the velocity; hierarchical flow matching instead models the full conditional velocity law with a second, inner flow in velocity space, but this inner flow is asked to transport isotropic Gaussian noise to a multimodal target velocity distribution from scratch. Our key observation is that this inner source can be replaced by a closed-form surrogate built from a coreset of the target. CCVFM first compresses the target into weighted atoms using an entropic Sinkhorn coreset and lifts them to a Gaussian mixture. translated_title: 核心集诱导的条件速度流匹配
translated_abstract: 我们提出了核心集诱导的条件速度流匹配（CCVFM），这是一种生成模型，它通过由数据信息构建的源分布来增强分层整流流。标准流匹配仅回归速度的条件均值；而分层流匹配则通过速度空间中的第二个内部流来建模完整的条件速度规律，但这个内部流需要从头开始将各向同性高斯噪声传输到多峰的目标速度分布。我们的关键观察是：这个内部源可以被一个由目标核心集构建的闭式代理分布所替代。CCVFM首先使用熵正则化的Sinkhorn核心集将目标压缩为加权原子，并将其提升为高斯混合。由此诱导的条件速度规律是一个闭式高斯混合，无需学习神经采样器即可进行采样。基于该代理源训练的轻量级校正流，t...
tldr: 该论文提出CCVFM生成模型，通过熵Sinkhorn核心集构建闭式代理源替代分层整流流中内部流的高斯噪声源，使条件速度规律成为无需神经采样器即可采样的闭式高斯混合，并只需轻量级校正流即可完成训练。
en_tdlr: CCVFM replaces the isotropic Gaussian source of hierarchical rectified flow's inner flow with a closed-form coreset-induced surrogate, making the conditional velocity law a closed-form Gaussian mixture that is sampleable without a learned neural sampler and trainable with only a lightweight correction flow.
